phase: Phase 3: File playback in the AudioBus
summary: Pass, round 3, with no blocking and no nonblocking finding. The delta b000b91e..9d150f62 adds per-event invalidation in useSoundFiles (adversarial F1 fix), a try/catch around the unlock pulse (F2 fix), and a late-decode storage guard in decodeData, plus the committed adversarial suites and the shared comment-aware wiring parser (F3 fix). The security scope of the delta holds: every cache stays bounded by the mapped events, a failed event is never retried across map swaps, a late fetch or decode after a swap to an unmapped event stores nothing, the pulse catch hides no failure that leaves the context unusable, and no new URL or input surface exists. The round-2 probe passes 10 of 10 unchanged, the new delta probe passes 8 of 8, and the six-file targeted suite passes 53 of 53.

The delta holds four track commits on audited paths: 097231b2 (wiring parser, F3), 9d03b6bd (bus.ts, F1/F2), 353d5145 and 9d150f62 (plan evidence); chibi_sprouts commits 95cadeec, 8c7f2891, 8b35d7c1, 3910559f touch only sprout assets and the chibi plan.

Delta scope: `git diff b000b91e..9d150f62 --stat` on audited paths shows src/apk3d/audio/bus.ts (+29/-5), tests/apk3d/audio-files.adversarial.test.ts (new, 16 cases), tests/apk3d/audio-wiring.adversarial.test.ts (new, 8 cases), tests/apk3d/audio-wiring-parser.ts (new, shared parser), tests/apk3d/audio-wiring.test.ts (+17, case 6 now uses the parser), and the track plan. `git show --stat 9d03b6bd` confirms the fix commit changed only bus.ts. No fetch, URL, or event-name surface was added.

F1 fix and resource bounds: bus.ts:106-125 reads the previous map, and on null, a base change, or a changed or vanished event entry it deletes that event from buffers, pendingDecode, and loading. Probe D1: after a decode, useSoundFiles(null) leaves the cleared event on the synth recipe with the stale file silent (gameSourceStarts stays 1, one fetch total). Probe D2: a swap to a map without the event clears the buffer and starts no fetch. Probe D7: wiring one equal map object twice still fetches once, so unchanged events keep their decoded or in-flight file.

No retry storms: the failed set is untouched by useSoundFiles, and probe D3 held one fetch total across six alternating swaps of a failed event between two entries. The state maps stay bounded by the mapped event count because invalidation deletes per event and nothing appends without the requestFile guards (bus.ts:258-267).

Late fetch and decode after a swap: the decodeData guard at bus.ts:293 stores a buffer only when the event is still mapped, and probe D4 shows a fetch that resolves after its event vanished stores nothing playable, starts no new fetch, and the event plays the synth recipe. Probe D8 shows a changed entry refetches exactly once on the next play with no loop.

Late fetch after dispose: probe D5 reran the round-2 dispose case; a fetch resolving after dispose takes no decode on the closed context and no game source starts. The committed case at tests/apk3d/audio-files.adversarial.test.ts:407-432 additionally pins that the late bytes wait in pendingDecode and decode on a later unlock with no refetch; pendingDecode holds at most one ArrayBuffer per event and is cleared by dispose, by a map clear, and by consumption at unlock (bus.ts:168-171), so the retention is bounded and test-pinned as intended.

F2 fix and failure containment: the unlock pulse at bus.ts:174-181 sits in a try/catch after master and musicGain are connected (bus.ts:161-166) and before the unconditional resume (bus.ts:182) and the mood restart (bus.ts:183). Probe D6: with the fake createBuffer throwing, unlock does not throw, resume still runs once, and the bus stays usable for synth playback. Probe S8 and S9 from the round-2 probe rerun unchanged at 10 of 10: the pulse stays one silent source per context and dispose adds no stop, and the suspended and closed-context unlock paths stay non-throwing, so the catch hides no failure that leaves the context in a bad state.

No new URL or input surface: the only URL construction stays bus.ts:264, and a grep of the delta for https?://, api keys, tokens, secrets, passwords, bearer, fetch(, new URL, XMLHttpRequest, and WebSocket found no match outside the pre-existing test fetch mocks. Hostile event names still never reach a URL (probe S1), entries flow verbatim (S2), and the base stays unrestricted (S2b).
Secrets and sensitive data: the delta adds no audio file and no credential; the wiring parser processes committed host source text at test time only, with no runtime input.
A2: not applicable. A grep of the delta for published, draft, consent, and anonymi found no match, and the track holds no personal data and no publish gate.

A6: the plan T6e/T6f records at measure/tracks/audio_game_integration_20261014/plan.md:404-442 claim F1=FIX, F2=FIX, F3=FIX(Red) with a five-file 45-of-45 gate. The three defect pins were committed failing-first (adversarial-p3-1e610cdb.json failed at status fail on exactly F1, F2, F3 at 1e610cdb), and my six-file rerun passes 53 of 53 including the 24 adversarial cases, so no security state is overstated. The tsc baseline is unchanged: exit 2 with 51 errors, 35 in assets/ and 16 in tests/, zero in src/apk3d/audio/bus.ts or any changed file.

Observation, no finding: the decodeData guard checks event presence, not entry equality, so an in-flight fetch whose entry changed re-stores the old bytes under the event and masks the refetch; the committed case at tests/apk3d/audio-files.adversarial.test.ts:346-365 pins exactly this. Both maps come from the same trusted caller in one wiring call, so no trust boundary is crossed, and the behavior is test-pinned.

Observation, no finding: after dispose, a late successful fetch stores its bytes in pendingDecode for a later unlock instead of dropping them; this is bounded and pinned at tests/apk3d/audio-files.adversarial.test.ts:407-432.

Independence and CONTEST: I did not read the review-a and review-c result files that share the run folder. No CONTEST item reached Review B in rounds 1 or 2, and this round opens no finding to contest.
